description: This file contains styling functions for a collapsible sidenav component in a React Material Dashboard project, defining styles for collapse items, icons, and text.

methods.name: collapseItem
methods.description: Defines styles for a collapsible sidenav item based on theme and owner state.

methods.name: collapseIconBox
methods.description: Defines styles for the icon box within the collapsible sidenav item.

methods.name: collapseIcon
methods.description: Returns style object for the collapse icon based on active state.

methods.name: collapseText
methods.description: Defines styles for the text label in the collapsible sidenav, including responsive opacity and margin.
